headings: Buy X Get Y at Z% Discount
text: This is the most common type of promotion and covers promos like buy 1 get 1 free, buy 2 get 1 for 50% off, and with a Buy Quantity of 0 (zero) promotions like get 1 for 50% (a quantity limited percent discount).
